en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a spa town nestled in forested hills. Grand spa buildings with domes and colonnades line broad promenades and park-like gardens. A tall smokestack emits smoke near the center. In the foreground is a building labeled "HOTEL NEW-YORK" and other town structures. At the top center of the card the caption "Marienbad." is printed in red lettering.
